name: Influenza Positive Laboratory Tests by Type and Subtype

Metadata.Time Period: October 2010 through the most recent date shown

columns.name: mmwr_week
columns.description: A weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: week
columns.description: The calendar week standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: week_start
columns.description: Beginning date of the MMWR week.

columns.name: week_end
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week.

columns.name: season
columns.description: Annually recurring reporting period for which estimates are calculated, beginning during MMWR week 40 and ending with week 39 of the following year.

columns.name: characteristic_category
columns.description: Overall category of  influenza test result or characteristic (e.g., Influenza Type or Influenza A Subtype).

columns.name: characteristic_group
columns.description: Specific influenza test result or characteristic (e.g., Influenza A (H3N2) or Influenza B). This is a subset of the characteristic category.

columns.name: count
columns.description: Total number of specimens that were positive for the specified characteristic group as reported by participating laboratories.

columns.name: count_pct
columns.description: Percentage of specimens that were positive for the specified characteristic group as reported by participating laboratories.  Note: Characteristic group ‘Total Positive’ will always be 100%.

columns.name: count_cumulative
columns.description: Total number of specimens that were positive for the specified characteristic group in the specified season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 39 of the following year.

columns.name: count_cum_pct
columns.description: Percentage of specimens that were positive for the specified characteristic group in the specified season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 39 of the following year. Note: Characteristic group ‘Total Positive’ will always be 100%.

columns.name: current_week_ending
columns.description: Ending date of the the MMWR week for the current season.
